integrity: Proof is self-contained except the classical elliptic Frobenius recurrence and Weil bound; a pure-Python finite-field enumerator checks 32 fields but is not the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the unweighted full inverse-square graph, two-frequency fourth moment, and all finite fields; no higher moments or pointwise exponential sum evaluation. A few plausible fourth-moment articles were accessible only through abstract or metadata, so historical priority is qualified.
title: Elliptic Frobenius traces in the additive energy of the inverse-square graph
